  limit = { HSM_AET_can_hear = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_hearing_done } }
  set_country_flag = HSM_AET_hearing_done
set_country_flag = HSM_AET_dismiss_without_compensation
if = { limit = { has_character = AET_count_cloudet }
 if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } promote_character = { character = AET_count_cloudet ideology = conservatism } }
 else = { set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no } promote_character = { character = AET_count_cloudet ideology = despotism } }
 set_country_flag = HSM_AET_count_restored
 } else = {
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = HSM_AET_civic_council } } recruit_character = HSM_AET_civic_council }
 set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
 promote_character = HSM_AET_civic_council
 set_country_flag = HSM_AET_council_restored
 }
 if = { limit = { has_character = CHN_trimmel } CHN_trimmel = { set_character_name = CHN_hivesmarschall_trimmel } }
 clr_country_flag = HSM_AET_trimmel_ratified
add_stability = -0.08
HSM_AET_refresh = yes
 }
}

HSM_AET_ratify_trimmel = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_AET_can_hear = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_hearing_done } NOT = { has_political_power < 75 } }
  add_political_power = -75
set_country_flag = HSM_AET_hearing_done
set_country_flag = HSM_AET_ratify_trimmel
set_country_flag = HSM_AET_trimmel_ratified
 CHN_trimmel = { set_character_name = CHN_hivesmarschall_trimmel }
 set_portraits = { character = CHN_trimmel civilian = { large = "gfx/leaders/CHN/Trimmel.tga" } }
 add_stability = -0.05
HSM_AET_refresh = yes
 }
}

HSM_AET_settle_identity = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_AET_can_sign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_signature_done } NOT = { has_political_power < 35 } }
  add_political_power = -35
set_country_flag = HSM_AET_signature_done
clr_country_flag = HSM_AET_identity_pending
 if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_investigate_quiet } add_stability = -0.05 }
 else = { add_stability = 0.05 }
HSM_AET_refresh = yes
 }
}

HSM_AET_register_cores = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_AET_regency = yes }
  every_owned_state = {
 limit = { HSM_VER_GRO_herzland_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = PREV NOT = { is_core_of = AET } }
 set_state_flag = HSM_AET_temporary_core add_core_of = AET
}
 }
}

HSM_AET_remove_temporary_cores = {
 if = {
  limit = { always = yes }
  every_state = {
 limit = { has_state_flag = HSM_AET_temporary_core }
 remove_core_of = AET clr_state_flag = HSM_AET_temporary_core
}
 }
}

HSM_AET_register_union_cores = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_AET_union_work = yes has_country_flag = HSM_AET_union_done }
  every_owned_state = {
 limit = { HSM_VER_GRO_herzland_state = yes is_fully_controlled_by = PREV }
 clr_state_flag = HSM_AET_temporary_core add_core_of = AET
}
 }
}

HSM_AET_finish_workshops = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_AET_active = yes has_country_flag = HSM_AET_congress_done NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_workshops_done } }
  set_country_flag = HSM_AET_workshops_done
if = {
 limit = { any_owned_state = { is_core_of = AET is_fully_controlled_by = PREV OR = { state = 495 state = 496 } free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = yes } } }
 random_owned_state = {
 limit = { is_core_of = AET is_fully_controlled_by = PREV OR = { state = 495 state = 496 } free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = yes } }
 add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
 add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
 }
} else = { add_tech_bonus = { name = HSM_AET_workshops bonus = 1 uses = 1 category = industry } }
HSM_AET_refresh = yes
 }
}

HSM_AET_finish_roads = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_AET_active = yes has_country_flag = HSM_AET_congress_done NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_roads_done } }
  set_country_flag = HSM_AET_roads_done
every_owned_state = { limit = { is_fully_controlled_by = PREV OR = { state = 495 state = 496 state = 382 } infrastructure < 5 } add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes } }
HSM_AET_refresh = yes
 }
}

HSM_AET_finish_scholars = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_AET_active = yes has_country_flag = HSM_AET_congress_done NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_scholars_done } }
  set_country_flag = HSM_AET_scholars_done
add_tech_bonus = { name = HSM_AET_scholars bonus = 1 uses = 2 category = electronics }
 decrease_illiteracy = yes
HSM_AET_refresh = yes
 }
}

HSM_AET_finish_demobilisation = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_AET_active = yes has_country_flag = HSM_AET_congress_done NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_demobilisation_done } }
  set_country_flag = HSM_AET_demobilisation_done
army_experience = 50
 decrease_poverty = yes
HSM_AET_refresh = yes
 }
}

  limit = { HSM_AET_active = yes }
  
 }
}

HSM_AET_refresh = {
 if = {
  limit = { HSM_AET_spirit_active = yes }
  set_variable = { HSM_AET_value_army_org_factor = 0 }
set_variable = { HSM_AET_value_consumer_goods_factor = 0 }
set_variable = { HSM_AET_value_industry_repair_factor = 0 }
set_variable = { HSM_AET_value_political_power_factor = 0 }
set_variable = { HSM_AET_value_political_power_gain = 0 }
set_variable = { HSM_AET_value_production_factory_max_efficiency_factor = 0 }
set_variable = { HSM_AET_value_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0 }
set_variable = { HSM_AET_value_research_speed_factor = 0 }
set_variable = { HSM_AET_value_stability_factor = 0 }
set_variable = { HSM_AET_value_supply_consumption_factor = 0 }
set_variable = { HSM_AET_value_training_time_army_factor = 0 }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_home_public } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_stability_factor = 0.05 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_home_credit } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_political_power_gain = -0.1 } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0.05 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_school_open } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_research_speed_factor = 0.05 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_school_court } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_political_power_factor = 0.1 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_accounts_public } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_stability_factor = 0.05 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_accounts_patron } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_consumer_goods_factor = -0.05 } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_political_power_gain = -0.1 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_service_law } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_army_org_factor = 0.05 } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_supply_consumption_factor = -0.05 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_service_contract } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_army_org_factor = 0.1 } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_consumer_goods_factor = 0.05 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_judge_patron } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_stability_factor = 0.05 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_protect_patron } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_political_power_gain = -0.1 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_delegates_equal } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_stability_factor = 0.05 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_delegates_population } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_political_power_factor = 0.1 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_revenues_local } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_stability_factor = 0.05 } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_industry_repair_factor = 0.15 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_revenues_central } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0.1 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_succession_assembly } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_political_power_factor = 0.1 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_succession_council } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_consumer_goods_factor = -0.05 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_workshops_done } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0.1 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_roads_done } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_supply_consumption_factor = -0.1 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_scholars_done } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_research_speed_factor = 0.05 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_demobilisation_done } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_training_time_army_factor = -0.1 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_trimmel_ratified } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_army_org_factor = 0.05 } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_political_power_gain = -0.15 } }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_handover_done } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_production_factory_max_efficiency_factor = 0.1 } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_research_speed_factor = 0.05 } }
 if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AET_identity_pending } add_to_variable = { HSM_AET_value_stability_factor = -0.10 } }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = HSM_AET_compact } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = HSM_AET_compact } }
 force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
 }
}
